findings.title: Preserve a working reviewer for image-based reviews
findings.problem: The sole reviewer is now text-only, with no vision-capable alternative. Consequently, review() always throws for nonempty images, and runReview() unconditionally fails any change containing an attached PNG. This disables the previously supported rendered-visual review path rather than migrating it to another reviewer.
findings.failure_scenario: An existing diagram or visual-exhibit review calls review(prompt, tokens, { images: [png] }) and fails before making a request, regardless of the visual's correctness. A PR updating a canonical PNG likewise cannot pass the trusted review gate. The replacement tests confirm refusal but no longer exercise any successful image-review route.
findings.fix: Keep the text-only default if desired, but select a registered, cross-family vision-capable reviewer whenever images are present in either review path. Record the selected model and retain an integration test proving that both image versions reach that reviewer. Alternatively, retain a vision-capable global reviewer.

assessment: The image guards correctly fail closed, but the global model switch leaves the existing visual-review functionality without a working reviewer.
